description: CALL THIS FIRST, before you start reverse engineering any device (drone, camera, router, plug, robot, wearable...). It tells you whether the protocol or a free firmware already exists, whether someone is working on it right now (live claims), and gives a one-line recommendation (e.g. "open firmware exists: use X", "claimed by Y until Z: contact them"). Give identifiers when you have them (FCC id, USB vid:pid, BLE name, Zigbee model): they match better than names. The record's `install` routes (when present) say how to put the open firmware on the device: official guide, installer, difficulty, safety flags. If it answers found: false, nothing is known: call claim_device before starting.

fcc_id.description: FCC ID from the label, e.g. "SS3-NEO2". Identifiers are the most reliable match.

id.description: OpenDeviceDB id (<vendor-slug>/<model-slug>) if you already have it, e.g. from search_devices.

model.description: Model name as printed on the device or box, e.g. "Neo 2".

usb.description: USB vendor:product id in lowercase hex, e.g. "2ca3:001f" (from lsusb).

zigbee_model.description: Zigbee modelId reported by the device.

name: lookup_device
title: Look up a device before reverse engineering it
